scope: static instruction and stack-reference counts over tests/benchmark/programs; NOT runtime

compilers.value_only: this patch with cast_preserves_offset_value temporarily reduced to cast_preserves_integer_value; MEASUREMENT-ONLY build variant, the knob is NOT shipped
compilers.ring_aware: this patch as shipped: cast_preserves_offset_value (default arm)

reproduce_value_only_arm: in src/passes/iv_strength_reduce.rs, make cast_preserves_offset_value return cast_preserves_integer_value(from, to) unconditionally, rebuild with scripts/build_lccc_fast.sh, re-run the same -O2 -march=x86-64-v3 sweep
conclusion: the ring-aware arm is byte-for-byte neutral against the base over all 55 programs; the value-only arm costs +15 instructions across 5 programs and gains 6 on one (sqlite_varint, an unprofitable reduction accidentally suppressed)
